desc: 【主線】吟遊詩人口中的傳說洞窟，深處插著能擊退魔王的勇者之劍。

entrance.desc: 你站在傳說洞窟的入口，潮濕陰冷的空氣中夾雜著詭異的魔力波動，每一次呼吸都讓人隱隱不安。
entrance.desc_en: You stand at the entrance to the Legendary Cave. The damp, cold air carries an eerie pulse of magic, and every breath leaves you faintly uneasy.

c1.desc: 狹窄的通道向前延伸，牆上的螢光苔蘚發出微弱的光，勉強照亮腳下的路。
c1.desc_en: A narrow passage stretches onward. Faintly glowing moss on the walls casts just enough light to make out the path beneath your feet.

c2.desc: 一條死路，盡頭只有不斷滲水的石壁。
c2.desc_en: A dead end. Nothing here but a stone wall continually seeping with water.

c3.desc: 岔路口瀰漫著刺鼻的硫磺味，令人頭暈目眩。
c3.desc_en: A pungent smell of sulfur fills this fork in the path, leaving you dizzy and disoriented.

c4.desc: 腳下的地面開始向下傾斜，魔力的氣息愈發濃郁，皮膚傳來陣陣刺痛。
c4.desc_en: The ground beneath your feet begins to slope downward. The scent of magic grows thicker, and your skin prickles with stinging pain.

c5.desc: 盡頭是一灘發黑的積水，散發著腐朽的氣味，沒有路可以再走了。
c5.desc_en: The path ends in a pool of blackened water reeking of decay. There is nowhere left to go.

c6.desc: 盡頭堆著一堆風化的骸骨，似乎是先前挑戰者留下的……你不敢多看。
c6.desc_en: A pile of weathered bones lies at the dead end, likely the remains of some past challenger... you dare not look too closely.

c7.desc: 牆壁上刻著古老的符文，幽幽發著光，但路到此為止。
c7.desc_en: Ancient runes are carved into the wall, glowing faintly, but the path ends here.

c8.desc: 通道在此一分為二，其中一側隱約透出柔和的微光。
c8.desc_en: The passage splits into two here. One side faintly glimmers with a soft light.

c9.desc: 死路，地面散落著破碎的劍鞘碎片，看來不是第一個來到這裡的人。
c9.desc_en: A dead end. Shattered fragments of a sword sheath litter the ground — it seems you are not the first to come this way.

c10.desc: 盡頭只有一面光滑的石牆，什麼都沒有，連回音都顯得格外空洞。
c10.desc_en: Nothing but a smooth stone wall at the end. There's nothing here at all — even the echo feels hollow.

c11.desc: 微弱的聖光從遠處透出，奇妙的是，周圍濃郁的魔力波動似乎也跟著減弱了一些。
c11.desc_en: A faint holy light shines from somewhere ahead. Strangely, the thick pulse of magic around you seems to weaken a little as well.

c12.desc: 聖光越來越清晰，你的腳步聲在空洞的石室中迴盪，心跳也隨之加快。
c12.desc_en: The holy light grows clearer. Your footsteps echo through the hollow stone chamber, and your heartbeat quickens.

c13.desc: 死路，只有冰冷的石壁回應著你的腳步聲。
c13.desc_en: A dead end. Only the cold stone walls answer the sound of your footsteps.

c14.desc: 死路，地上有一個破碎的石碑，碑文已經風化難以辨認。
c14.desc_en: A dead end. A shattered stone tablet lies on the ground, its inscription too weathered to read.

sword_room.desc: 你來到了一座圓形石室，正中央的石墩上，插著一把散發著聖潔光輝的長劍——【勇者之劍】！
sword_room.desc_en: You arrive in a round stone chamber. Upon a pedestal at its center stands a longsword radiating holy light — the [Hero's Sword]!

desc_en: [Main Quest] The legendary cave spoken of by bards, said to hold deep within it the Hero's Sword capable of driving back the Demon Lord.
